macros.name: coursename
macros.doc: The default replacement text for \coursename is “Course Name”.

macros.name: examname
macros.doc: The default replacement text for \examname is “Exam Name”.

macros.name: instructions
macros.doc: The default replacement text for \instructions is “Instructions Here”.

macros.name: instructorname
macros.doc: The default replacement text for \instructorname is “Instructor Name”.

macros.name: printcover
macros.doc: The command \printcover executes either \coveranswers or \covernoanswers, depending on the value of the boolean printanswers.

macros.name: printworkspace
macros.doc: To include the content of \workspace only when the boolean printanswers is FALSE, use the command \printworkspace.

macros.name: termname
macros.doc: The default replacement text for \termname is “Term Name”.

macros.name: workspace
macros.doc: The command \workspace is intended to provide additional work space on the exam, perhaps at the end of the questions.

envs.name: qbitem
envs.doc: The qbitem environment allows for the inclusion of the various environments for parts and solutions that are provided by the exam class.

envs.name: questionbank
envs.doc: The questionbank environment randomly generates an integer between 1 and the number specified in the preceding command \setnumberofquestions.

envs.name: versions
envs.doc: The versions environment uses a loop and a counter version to generate versions of the exam, incrementing the counter and updating the page numbers along the way.
